rules.title: Keep capability ownership explicit
rules.applies_when: A change adds or moves a business capability.
rules.evidence: Change spec, module boundaries, public interfaces, and affected call sites.
rules.exceptions: An approved decision record may authorize a temporary cross-module owner.
rules.decision_limit: Do not infer ownership only from the current file location.

rules.title: Use approved public boundaries
rules.applies_when: One module reads or mutates another module's behavior or state.
rules.evidence: Imports, public protocols or APIs, dependency direction, and tests.
rules.exceptions: Only a matching approved decision record.
rules.decision_limit: Do not mark a dependency invalid solely because two types live in different directories.

rules.title: Preserve state ownership
rules.applies_when: The change creates, copies, caches, or mutates state.
rules.evidence: State declarations, mutation paths, synchronization behavior, and regression checks.
rules.exceptions: Approved replicated state with an explicit synchronization contract.
rules.decision_limit: Do not demand a new abstraction when the existing owner is adequate.

rules.title: Keep governance definitions outside feature changes
rules.applies_when: A governed feature change is prepared or verified.
rules.evidence: Protected-path digest and the change baseline.
rules.exceptions: None inside a feature run; use recalibration.
rules.decision_limit: A feature reviewer cannot waive this rule.
